create.name: Ilana Beigel
create.bio:
Ilana Beigel is a yoga and meditation teacher in Amherst, Massachusetts, and a long-standing member of the Kripalu teaching community. She first worked as a speech therapist, with a master's degree in that field, and had practised yoga since the late 1990s before a quieter period in her own life drew her into its philosophy. A training at Kripalu followed, and she went on to complete Kripalu's 500-hour Ayurvedic yoga and 200-hour vinyasa certifications, with further study in restorative yoga, yoga nidra, Reiki and the Bhagavad Gita. She is also a certified facilitator of RISE, Kripalu's programme on resilience.

Her teaching keeps returning to dharma, the yogic idea of each person's own purpose, and to making older yogic tools workable in ordinary family and working life. At Kripalu she leads welcome weekends, vinyasa teacher training modules and online dharma workshops, and her gentle yoga classes and guided meditations can be found on Kripalu's YouTube channel. Nearer home she teaches outdoor classes in Amherst, gives private lessons, mentors other yoga teachers and has co-led international retreats, including one in the Azores. She writes about purpose and presence on her Substack, Truth, Illuminated. Her manner is light and nurturing, with plenty of room for reflection.

videos.title: How to Find your Life Purpose (Dharma) - Practical Tools for Clarity & Alignment

courses.title: The Great Work of Your Life: A New Year Dharma Reflection
courses.description: A ninety-minute evening workshop online through Kripalu, held as the year turns. Using meditation, reflection and journaling, you explore the yogic idea of dharma and what you want the coming year to be about.

courses.title: Essential Practices for Everyday Life: Practical Tools from the Kripalu Path (New Year weekend)
courses.description: A New Year weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge that introduces the centre's approach: Kripalu Yoga, meditation, simple daily self-care and time in nature. Ilana co-leads this date with Cristie Newhart.

courses.title: Private Yoga Lessons and Teacher Mentoring
courses.description: One-to-one or small-group sessions shaped around you, mixing postures, breathing, meditation and help building a home practice. She also mentors yoga teachers on sequencing, language and weaving a theme through a class.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditation with Ilana Beigel
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation of about 24 minutes on Kripalu's YouTube channel, led by Ilana from settling the body through to quiet sitting.

free_resources.title: Truth, Illuminated (Substack)
free_resources.description: Her free newsletter of short reflections and images on purpose, presence and the yogic path, sent to subscribers by email.
